#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

vector<ll> fact;

ll pow(ll x, int y) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = (res * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll inv(ll a) {
    return pow(a, MOD - 2);
}

ll choose(int a, int b) {
    ll res = (fact[a] * inv((fact[b] * fact[a - b]) % MOD)) % MOD;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N;
    ll pk;
    cin >> N >> pk;

    if (pk > N - 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int k = (int)pk;
    fact.resize(N + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (i * fact[i - 1]) % MOD;
    }

    ll ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    int c = N - k;
    int i = c;
    while (i >= 0) {
        ll term = (choose(c, i) * pow(i, N)) % MOD;
        term = (sign * term) % MOD;
        ans = (ans + term + MOD) % MOD;
        sign = -sign;
        --i;
    }
    ans = (ans * choose(N, c)) % MOD;
    if (k > 0) {
        ans = (2 * ans) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
